final: WITH per_gender AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS invoiced_order_count FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), overall AS (SELECT AVG(invoiced_order_count) AS avg_count FROM per_gender) SELECT AVG(p.invoiced_order_count) AS above_average_gender_avg_order_count, AVG(p.invoiced_order_count - o.avg_count) AS avg_excess_overall_average FROM per_gender p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.invoiced_order_count > o.avg_count
